parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

parameters.name: ReturnForm
parameters.description:
The format of the returned image.

- If this parameter is not set, a four-channel PNG image is returned.
- If this parameter is set to `mask`, a single-channel mask is returned.
- If this parameter is set to `whiteBK`, an image with a white background is returned.
